other_failure_modes.name: Suboptimal missing value handling for tree models
other_failure_modes.description: The agent manually imputes missing values with the median before feeding data into LightGBM, which natively handles NaNs and can learn optimal splits for missing data. Imputing with the median destroys this signal.

summary: The agent implements a solid LightGBM regression pipeline with sensible feature engineering and K-Fold cross-validation. The main minor issues are a slight data leakage during cross-validation (because median imputation is applied to the full training set before splitting) and the manual imputation of NaNs which prevents LightGBM from utilizing its native missing-value handling.
